content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric utility delivering power to customers over owned networks, though it also runs telecom and serves remote areas."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Water and wastewater utility; different product from Con Edison's electricity, gas and steam delivery."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric and natural gas delivery utility serving residential and commercial customers over owned networks."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas and electric distribution utility; propane is a secondary line."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Water and sewer utility in Arizona; does not deliver electricity, gas or steam."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contractor doing installation and maintenance work, not owning and operating utility delivery networks."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Water and wastewater utility plus contract operations; different product from energy delivery."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas delivery utility to homes and businesses, with clean energy projects alongside, similar to Con Edison."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers over owned pipeline networks."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution utility serving homes and businesses; propane delivery is a secondary line."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Propane and fuel oil delivered by truck to tanks; not a regulated network utility delivering electricity or gas."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric transmission, distribution and natural gas utility serving residential and commercial customers."}]}
